bagPolicy.summary: Only clear totes up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches or nonclear clutches up to 6 × 9 inches may enter. There is no bag check at the gates.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: General parking is included with a concert ticket. EZ Out, Front Row and Ultra Premier are paid upgrades; oversized vehicles need an advance pass.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: Use the designated pickup and drop-off area inside the theme park parking entrance. Drivers should use the far-right toll lane.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and drinks are available for purchase; each guest may bring food in a clear one-gallon bag. The allowed-items guide lists event-specific water restrictions.
allowed: Food in one clear one-gallon bag
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible pickup and drop-off are inside the theme park parking entrance; contact the amphitheater for seating and arrival support.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The amphitheater visitor guide does not publish a general rule for re-entry after leaving a concert.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Will Call is available when doors are open; bring photo ID, including for artist guest-list tickets.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Entrances are the South Gate, North Gate, and VIP Club entrance, and all are accessible. The dedicated accessible entrance is in the VIP parking lot, across from the accessible parking lot. Gate times vary by event, so check your event page.
